hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); SID=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.session_id // "unknown"'); if echo "$CMD" | grep -Eqi 'composer install|npm (install|ci)|yarn install|pnpm install'; then if [ -f "/tmp/claude-install-retry-guard/${SID}.blocked" ]; then jq -n --arg reason "A package-registry install already failed in this session with a network/auth error. Do not retry composer/npm/yarn/pnpm install - the registry or proxy is unreachable/rate-limited from this sandbox. Rely on CI to validate dependency-related changes instead, or ask the user how to proceed." '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"deny",permissionDecisionReason:$reason}}'; fi; fi

INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if echo "$CMD" | grep -Eqi 'composer install|npm (install|ci)|yarn install|pnpm install'; then if echo "$INPUT" | grep -Eqi 'could not authenticate against github|curl error 28|proxy CONNECT aborted|connection reset by peer|could not resolve host|operation timed out|407 Proxy Authentication Required|ECONNRESET|ETIMEDOUT'; then SID=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.session_id // "unknown"'); mkdir -p /tmp/claude-install-retry-guard; echo "$CMD" > "/tmp/claude-install-retry-guard/${SID}.blocked"; fi; fi
